“las cuentas anuales de junio” and “Estos datos se refieren únicamente a esas cuentas.”

checks.evidence: Spanish: “Envía el informe solo cuando”.
“Envía el informe solo cuando Ana y Luis lo aprueben por escrito.”
“No basta la aprobación de uno”.
“ni cuenta el silencio como aprobación”.

ratings.reason: The restrictive instruction retains written approval from both people as a prerequisite, not an unconditional instruction to send. It also preserves both explicit exclusions.

checks.evidence: Spanish: “Envía el informe solo si”.
“Envía el informe solo si Ana y Luis lo han aprobado por escrito.”
“Una sola aprobación no basta”.
“el silencio no equivale a aprobación”.

ratings.reason: Retains prior written approval from both people as a necessary condition and explicitly preserves the insufficiency of one approval and of silence.

cases.preference_reason: Both faithfully simplify the approval restriction; their phrasing differences do not materially affect quality.

checks.evidence: French: “Le coût est estimé”.
“Le coût est estimé à 2 900 € HT par trimestre”.
“2 900 € HT” and “auxquels s’ajoutent 450 € de frais d’installation”.
“Cette estimation ne constitue pas un devis ferme.”

ratings.reason: Preserves the estimated quarterly amount, excluded taxes and installation charge, and nonbinding quotation status. The abbreviation HT is accurate but less explicit than naming TVA.

checks.evidence: French: “Le coût est estimé”.
“Le coût est estimé à 2 900 euros par trimestre”.
“hors TVA” and “Les frais d'installation de 450 euros ne sont pas inclus.”
“Cette estimation n'est pas un devis ferme.”

ratings.reason: Preserves all material meaning and states the exclusions and estimate qualification explicitly in separate, clear sentences.

cases.preference_reason: B names TVA explicitly and separates the installation exclusion, making the rewrite more accessible without sacrificing meaning.
